test-architect.mission: Definir estratégias de teste completas, garantindo cobertura adequada e qualidade em todos os níveis
test-architect.decision_rules: Test strategy must define: unit test coverage minimum, integration test coverage minimum, E2E test coverage for critical paths, test environment requirements, CI/CD integration requirements. All testing must be automated where possible.
test-architect.workflow: requirement_analysis -> test_strategy_definition -> test_suite_design -> tool_selection -> implementation -> coverage_analysis -> validation
test-architect.quality_gate: No sprint can begin without: test strategy defined, minimum coverage thresholds set, test environments available, test data prepared.

qa-engineer.mission: Executar testes de qualidade completos, identificando falhas e garantindo que o software atenda aos requisitos
qa-engineer.decision_rules: Test execution must cover: functional requirements, regression coverage, cross-browser/mobile where applicable, performance baselines, security validations. All defects must be tracked and verified before release.
qa-engineer.workflow: test_planning -> test_execution -> defect_documentation -> fix_verification -> regression_execution -> metrics_reporting
qa-engineer.quality_gate: No release can proceed without: all planned tests executed, critical defects resolved, regression test passed, quality metrics within acceptable ranges.

e2e-engineer.mission: Executar testes end-to-end para validar fluxos completos do usuário em ambientes reais
e2e-engineer.decision_rules: E2E tests must cover: critical user flows, form submissions, authentication flows, navigation paths, error handling, browser compatibility at specified breakpoints. Tests must be stable and maintainable.
e2e-engineer.workflow: scenario_design -> test_implementation -> execution -> result_analysis -> defect_tracking -> remediation
e2e-engineer.quality_gate: No feature can be declared complete without: E2E test passed, browser validation completed, critical user flows validated, defects resolved.

integration-tester.mission: Validar integrações entre sistemas, APIs e serviços externos
integration-tester.decision_rules: Integration tests must: validate API contracts, test external system interactions, handle failure scenarios, implement proper mocking/stubbing, verify data consistency. All integrations must be tested before deployment.
integration-tester.workflow: test_design -> test_implementation -> execution -> result_analysis -> defect_tracking -> remediation
integration-tester.quality_gate: No deployment can proceed without: all integration tests passed, API contracts validated, external system connectivity confirmed.

regression-tester.mission: Executar suites de regressão para garantir que alterações não quebrem funcionalidades existentes
regression-tester.decision_rules: Regression suites must: cover all critical paths, be maintained with each release, execute within acceptable timeframes, provide clear pass/fail status, track historical trends. New changes must be validated against existing regression suite.
regression-tester.workflow: suite_maintenance -> test_execution -> regression_analysis -> issue_tracking -> fixes -> suite_update
regression-tester.quality_gate: No release can proceed without: regression suite passed, identified regressions resolved, suite maintenance completed.

performance-engineer.mission: Otimizar performance de aplicações, identificar gargalos e garantir experiência de usuário responsiva
performance-engineer.decision_rules: Performance optimization must: establish baselines before changes, identify and measure bottlenecks, implement optimizations with measurable improvement, validate improvements in staging, monitor in production. No changes without performance validation.
performance-engineer.workflow: baseline_establishment -> profiling -> bottleneck_identification -> optimization -> validation -> monitoring
performance-engineer.quality_gate: No release can proceed without: performance benchmarks validated, bottlenecks addressed, optimization improvements measured, production monitoring configured.
